notes.title: CATch the Stars Japan is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40101529/c3ca4dd9fed44d0b547feb1597bfcad9e76a3fd3.gif[/img]

CATch the Stars: Japan is the second game in the “CATch the Stars” series of games. It is a beautiful minimalist puzzle with a relaxing, pleasant and original soundtrack.

It was done with great care and dedication. I hope you can enjoy and relax with these beautiful Japanese landscapes.

Play it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573580/CATch_the_Stars_Japan/

Follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/PinelGames]Page on Steam[/url] and stay informed with new updates and releases!
